techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's flagship office campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli stretch of the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, built in four phases (I-IV) of roughly twelve towers; the first phase (Building 1, East and West Wings) was built to JPMorgan Chase's specification and is still JPMorgan's main Bengaluru building, and the later star-named blocks (Etamin, Elnath, Electra, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter) were marketed as Exora Business Park. Phase IV (Cosmos, Vector, Velocity, Valence) sits on the western edge beside Helios Business Park. Sizes quoted by secondary sources conflict (about 9 acres across phases vs a '45-acre ecosystem' for phase IV), so no area is recorded.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: A 22-acre, roughly 4.5 million sq ft IT SEZ campus of 11 towers on the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, developed by Prestige Estates and now managed by Nucleus Office Parks. Cisco's Bengaluru campus (its Globalisation Centre East, buildings BGL 11-18 in OSM) takes up most of the SEZ; Walmart Global Tech, Micron and Sapiens occupy the numbered SEZ buildings 10-11, and the Aloft hotel and the three-block Prestige Tech Pacific Park sit inside the precinct. Property sites also name HCL, Cargill, Sixt R&D, Zensar and Xavient; only those with corroboration are listed.

techParks.name: Embassy Tech Square
techParks.description: Embassy Group's ~8-acre, 2.2 million sq ft non-SEZ office park at Kaverappa Layout, Kadubeesanahalli, on the inner side of the ORR between Cessna Business Park and Embassy TechVillage. Its four blocks are Omega, Alpha, Delta and Signet, so 'Embassy Signet' is a block here rather than a separate park. InMobi's headquarters is on the 7th floor of Delta; LG Soft India has its own building. A 2011-vintage listing also named Xiaomi India in Delta, but Xiaomi has since consolidated at Embassy TechVillage so it is not recorded as a current tenant. Coordinates are the mean of the Omega, InMobi and LG Soft OSM features; no park polygon exists in OSM.

techParks.name: Prestige Ferns Galaxy
techParks.description: A single-tenant Prestige office building at Sy. No. 7/1, 7/2, 8/1A Ambalipura, on the Outer Ring Road at the Bellandur Gate / Sarjapur Road junction, occupied by Microsoft India (R&D). It is the address Microsoft prints on Bengaluru offer letters and is Microsoft's largest ORR site; IndiQube Edge and Primeco The Hub are the neighbouring buildings.

techParks.name: Helios Business Park
aliases: Helios Business Park, 150 Outer Ring Road
techParks.description: A LEED Platinum office campus at No. 150 Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, immediately west of Prestige Tech Park IV and north of Salarpuria Touchstone. The Executive Centre's listing for its Towers C, D and E names Goldman Sachs and the Volkswagen Group as fellow occupiers; OSM places Meesho (Wing E) and MakeMyTrip inside the park. Goldman Sachs' owned Bengaluru campus is widely reported here but its own locations page could not be fetched, so the developer and size are left null.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Platina
techParks.description: Prestige's two-block office development on the Outer Ring Road frontage at the north-east corner of the Prestige Tech Park campus (Cushman & Wakefield lists Block 2 as about 457,000 sq ft, completed 2015). Adobe's own offices page gives 'Prestige Platina Technology Park, Building 1, Block A, Bangalore 560103' as one of its two Bengaluru addresses. Coordinates are the mid-point of the two unnamed 'Block 1'/'Block 2' office footprints on Outer Ring Road in OSM that carry the Adobe POIs; the block-to-footprint mapping is inferred, not mapped.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Pacific Park
techParks.description: A three-block Prestige office cluster beside the Aloft hotel inside the Cessna Business Park precinct, mapped in OSM as Prestige Tech Pacific Park (Blocks 1-3). Walmart Labs / Walmart Global Tech POIs sit in Block 1 and Bazaarvoice Technology India in Block 3; Walmart job postings name 'Pardhanani Wilshire II, Cessna Business Park', which is likely this frontage. No primary source for the park itself could be fetched, so tenants here are OSM-evidenced.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Touchstone
techParks.description: Two-block (A and B) Sattva office building at 15/1A Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, wedged between Helios Business Park and the Aricent/Capgemini campus. Walmart Global Tech lists '3rd Floor, Block B, Salarpuria Touchstone' as a Bengaluru office; OSM records Lumen (and its CenturyLink/Savvis predecessors), Riverbed and a Smartworks coworking centre here.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Knowledge Court
techParks.description: Sattva Group office campus on the Marathahalli-Brookefield side of the Outer Ring Road, just north of the Marathahalli bridge (Sattva's own site files it under Brookefield). OSM records Harman's India corporate headquarters, WNS and Netskope India inside the campus; none of the three companies' location pages could be fetched, so these tenants are OSM-evidenced only.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park
techParks.description: Vaishnavi Group's three-tower (North, Central, South) office park on Sarjapur Road at Bellandur Gate, a few hundred metres from Prestige Ferns Galaxy and the ORR junction. Vaishnavi's website renders its project list client-side and no tenant could be verified from a fetchable source; OSM has only small firms (Odessa, Khosla Labs) and an Uber POI on the park's southern edge, none confirmed, so the tenant list is left empty rather than guessed.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Square
techParks.description: A single Vaishnavi office building off 6th Main Road, Iblur, on the Sarjapur-side service road of the ORR near the Iblur junction. OSM records Navi (Sachin Bansal's Navi Technologies) here, consistent with Navi's published registered address; Navi's site refused the fetch, so this remains OSM-evidenced.

techParks.name: AKR Tech Park
aliases: AKR Tech Park, Krishna Reddy Industrial Area

It is best known as Myntra's former headquarters; OSM still carries a building named 'Myntra Designs Pvt Ltd' here, but Myntra moved its head office to Embassy TechVillage well before 2023, so no Myntra office is recorded at AKR in the companies list. A BHIVE coworking centre operates on the Hosur Road frontage.

techParks.name: SJR iPark
techParks.description: SJR Prime Corporation's office park in the EPIP Zone, Whitefield (Mobius and Warp towers in OSM), near the Kundalahalli ORR junction. It lies in the Whitefield belt rather than the Kadubeesanahalli stretch; the developer's domain is now parked and no tenant could be verified from a fetchable source, so the tenant list is left empty.

coverageNotes: Web search was exhausted early in this run (shared per-turn budget), so verification leaned on direct fetches of company pages plus OSM features; several corporate domains (Goldman Sachs, Walmart Tech, Akamai, Nutanix, Juniper/HPE, Harman, LG Soft, Oracle, Myntra, Meesho, Navi, Xiaomi, Cargill, Rubrik, Bazaarvoice, Netskope) returned 403/404/503 or rate-limited safety checks, and those offices are recorded at medium/low confidence with the reason stated. Primary (company-page) confirmations were obtained for Adobe (both buildings), Confluent, InMobi, Micron, Sapiens, KnowBe4, Amadeus (city only), Salesforce and Microsoft (via the IPC member directory). Lens tenants deliberately LEFT OUT because the evidence places their Bengaluru offices outside this stretch: Yahoo (Embassy GolfLinks), Akamai (locations page renders client-side; no address obtained), Qualcomm (Bagmane Constellation and EPIP Brookefield), Nokia (Manyata; it was a first-phase Prestige Tech Park tenant per the FIABCI entry but left long before 2023), Swiggy (not found on this stretch), Amazon (Bagmane WTC/Constellation), Intuit (Pritech Park/Ecospace, Bellandur), Palo Alto Networks and Lam Research (Bagmane Tech Park), Arm and Visa (Bagmane WTC), Applied Materials (ITPB, Whitefield), Pure Storage (no verifiable Bengaluru address), Oracle Health/Cerner (Manyata). Kalyani Platina is at Kundalahalli (Whitefield), not here, and is omitted; 'Embassy Signet' is a block of Embassy Tech Square and is recorded as an alias. Xiaomi India appeared only on a 2011-vintage Embassy Tech Square Delta listing and has since consolidated at Embassy TechVillage, so it is not recorded. LinkedIn, PwC, Schneider Electric and Bosch were named as Exora/Prestige Tech Park tenants in a 2015 release but OSM now places their Bengaluru offices elsewhere (RMZ Ecoworld, EGL/Bagmane, Brookefield, Ecospace), so they are omitted rather than recorded as closed (the moves predate 2023). Cargill is listed at Cessna by property sites but OSM places Cargill Business Services at Adarsh Palm Retreat, Bellandur; omitted. Myntra's former AKR Tech Park campus is described on the park entry but not recorded as a company office because the move to Embassy TechVillage predates 2023. Vaishnavi Tech Park and SJR iPark carry empty tenant lists because no tenant could be verified from a fetchable source (Uber and Odessa POIs near Vaishnavi Tech Park were not confirmed). Tower-level coordinates come from OSM building footprints where a named tower exists (Etamin, Elnath, Electra, Mercury, Velocity, Block 1); Cosmos, Cessna SEZ Buildings 10/11 and Torrey Pines are not mapped and use park centroids. The Prestige Tech Platina block-to-footprint mapping is inferred from the two Adobe POIs. Headcounts are null except Amadeus (4,000+, own careers page); no headcount was invented.
